patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient was brought to the emergency department because of sudden, painless loss of vision in her right eye that occurred 30 minutes ago while watching TV. She has a history of coronary artery disease, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus but has had trouble adhering to her medication regimen.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Sudden, painless loss of vision in the right eye

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Coronary artery disease, hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Has difficulty adhering to medication regimen

objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with sudden loss of vision in one eye.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’m a 60-year-old woman, and today I had a sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye about 30 minutes ago while I was watching TV. I have coronary artery disease, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes, and I’ve been having trouble sticking to my medications.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any small, raised bumps on your skin that have a tiny indentation or a "dimple" in the center?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any small raised bumps on my skin with a central indentation. I’ve just had the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye about 30 minutes ago, and I haven’t felt any other symptoms.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you need to urinate more often than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed I need to urinate more often than usual. I’ve mainly just had the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye about 30 minutes ago, and nothing else feels different.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling generally weak or lacking your usual strength lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t felt generally weak or lacking my usual strength lately. It’s mostly just the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that happened about 30 minutes ago while I was watching TV.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any difficulty with dressing yourself lately?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed any difficulty dressing myself, and I’m not feeling weaker than usual—this has mainly been the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago while I was watching TV.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing specifically along the veins in your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any rashes, bumps, or sores appearing along the veins in my arms—this has mainly been the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itchiness on your skin?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been experiencing any itchiness on my skin. I’ve mainly had the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago while I was watching TV.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you experience any pain in your calves when you walk that goes away once you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any pain in my calves when I walk that improves when I stop and rest. My main issue is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago while I was watching TV.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed if your stools have become unusually pale, light-colored, or clay-colored recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed my stools becoming unusually pale or clay-colored—I haven’t noticed any other changes besides the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye about 30 minutes ago while I was watching TV.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any weakness in your hands, such as difficulty gripping objects or opening jars?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any weakness in my hands—my gripping and opening jars feels normal. It’s mainly the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago while I was watching TV.”
